changes: Double-entry cells: click once to select and copy or paste a value; double-click to edit. Double-click an account to clear it, with the previous choice first.
Number editing preserves the remaining digits and caret when replacing part of an amount. Currency symbols are excluded from cell copying.
Multiple Dates starts from the selected main date. Restoring a draft preserves its individual row dates.

Exchange rates display thousands separators without losing rate precision. Ledger IDs and amount columns are compact; trial-balance amount columns have balanced widths. Account labels no longer contain DR/CR.
